about: Which university systems an AI agent can read on a student's behalf, per institution: the adapter, its status, when it was last tested, and the gotchas. Machine-first: query with the unitoolkit 'registry' tool, or fetch this file raw.

status_values.ok: the last automated or manual test passed
status_values.partial: works with a stated limit (see gotchas)
status_values.fail: the last test failed; the adapter needs a fix
status_values.untested: listed but never tested at this institution

canvas.adapter: unitoolkit: upcoming, assignment, search, announcements, discussions

ladok.auth: SWAMID SSO in a browser session; optional re-login with the browser's saved password

ezproxy.auth: institutional SSO in a browser session

sharepoint.auth: Entra ID SSO in a browser session

viva-engage.auth: Entra ID SSO in a browser session

gotchas: Announcements are hidden from the plain discussion list: ask for only_announcements.
Students may lack list access to pages and quizzes; read pages through module items.

Files attached to an assignment are readable by the token: courses/:id/files/:file_id returns a pre-signed url, then plain GET. The web path /courses/:id/files/:file_id/download is a browser route and 302s to shh.se without a Canvas session, which looks like an empty download. Ids scraped from an assignment description are not all course files (banners, emoji): those answer 404.
Logged out, the data endpoint answers HTTP 200 with the HTML app shell: check for a JSON body, not the status.
Session cookies only: every new browser session logs in again.
Chrome releases an autofilled password only after a user-gesture click; a background tab draws no frames, so bring it to front first.
Read-only scope here: registration windows. Not results, certificates or ISP.
schedule() returns {objects, bookings}; bookings are dicts, not rows.
Room booking: 08-20 weekdays, 3 days ahead, max 4 h.
Cloudflare in front; some home IPs get port 443 dropped and plain HTTP clients get 429: a real browser behind a sticky residential proxy works.
A Koha session is bound to the client IP: a rotating proxy logs you out ('logging from a different IP').
Koha 25+ needs login_op=cud-login or the form re-renders silently.
The SSO hand-back is a cross-site POST that drops a SameSite=Lax CGISESSID.
Koha 26 renamed the loans table to #checkoutst.
Account login is NOT probed automatically: failed logins count against the student's card.
EBSCO reads a space-separated query as one phrase: join terms with AND.
Use %20, not '+': EBSCO reads a literal plus as an operator.
Cochrane ignores Enter; click the search button, and check the first result changed.
Full text: capture the PDF at the network layer (CDP Fetch, Response stage); script downloads hit viewers or bot checks.
De Gruyter titles are not proxied.
Keep full-text pulls under 20/hour per student.
List REST ignores $skip on Site Pages: page by $filter=Id gt N.
Studenthjälpen AI (Copilot Studio) pane takes typed text but not a scripted Enter.
The separate APA-guide site (/sites/APA-guide) is the school's citation authority.
JSON API answers 406 without the SPA's token; read rendered thread pages.
Community feeds are virtualized and do not page back from a script: only linked or recent posts.
Thread/group URLs are base64 of {"_type":"Thread","id":"..."}.
deployments.note: status is manual: thread pages render, the community feed cannot be listed

gotchas: Crossref lowercases Cochrane DOIs.
Some Wiley titles carry a 'Portico.' prefix.
No site search is scraped: the page list comes from pagessitemap.xml (1190 pages) and queries match page paths, so a word that is not in a slug finds nothing.
Path matching folds diacritics, so 'hjartsvikt' finds 'hjärtsvikt'.
Answers 404 to non-browser User-Agents. Reading it means sending a browser UA past a block the site chose, so the reader refuses unless UNITOOLKIT_REFS_BROWSER_UA=1.
Binary downloads (.pdf, .doc*, .xls*) are refused by robots.txt and by the reader.
/session, /bookmark, /print and /cart paths are disallowed and refused.
No probe yet: reads fine by hand (ref_page), but nothing runs weekly against it.
/session, /bookmark, /print and /cart paths are refused.
